propositions: Code-review verdicts are assembled without setting the provider_provenance key, leaving every signed verdict with a missing provenance record.

The code-review gate verdict assembly path mirrors the defective pattern from story 343b's plan-review and completion gates before their fix, recording only bare model strings without provider endpoint or support tier attribution.

The provider_provenance record is computed once inside the runner via capabilities.provenance_for and stamped onto results by findings.finalize_outcome, but the code-review gate assembly seam does not wire this record through from the verify agent step to the terminal verdict.
The degraded/outage code-review verdict path (_degraded_code_review_verdict) must omit the provider_provenance key rather than synthesizing it from config when no model ran.
